roms.name: LineageOS 14.1 for TV

risk.why: Legacy Android 7.1.2 community build; December 2024 backported patches and SELinux permissive. This is not current Android security support.

rating.note: Installation depends on a supported unlockable hardware/firmware combination. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, display, hardware/software video decoding, audio, MTP and DRM are reported working by the maintainer. GMS/Google Apps are listed as buggy; DRM support does not guarantee every paid streaming service or 4K playback. No ROMinit hardware test. USB networking, OTG and encryption are not verified here.

roms.notes: A graphical TV interface operated with a remote, not a terminal-only ROM. Runs Android apps without the stock Amazon home screen. This is an unofficial, legacy LineageOS build; Google Apps have known issues and SELinux runs permissive. Installation is a community Linux USB unlock followed by TWRP/ADB work, not a browser installer. Check eligibility first.

external.why: Read the maintainer’s ROM guide and current unlock restrictions first. Eligible units use community Linux/FireISO USB tools to unlock and install TWRP, then the documented TWRP/ADB install path. ROMinit has not validated a WebUSB sideload or automated CLI recipe for mantis, and this link is a community guide, not an official flasher.

requirements: E9L29Y / AFTMM, codename mantis, first-generation Fire TV Stick 4K (2018) only.
Confirm exact hardware revision and installed Fire OS against the current unlock guide; eligibility is unknown until checked.
Successfully complete the applicable community unlock and install the matching TWRP before installing the ROM.
Back up data first. Unlock/install procedures can erase data; board work and unsupported downgrades can brick the stick.
Use the exact maintainer ROM package and instructions. Do not relock a community-modified bootloader.
An HDMI display, suitable USB data/power connections, and the host tools specified by the guide are required.
